title: HR Services Solution Owner - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced HR Services Solution Owner to lead a portfolio of employee journeys and services within HR Products & Services. You will act as the Product Owner for Hire-to-Retire workstreams, taking responsibility for process simplification, continuous improvement and value delivery through global HR platforms.

The role combines hands-on product ownership with team leadership. You will manage and prioritise product backlogs, shape future-state HR processes and work closely with Product Managers and stakeholders to deliver AI-enabled, automated and Copilot-supported solutions. This India-based role reports to the Lead HR Products and Services – Solution Owners.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Own HR Services workstreams across the Hire-to-Retire employee lifecycle.Manage, refine and prioritise the product backlog in line with business goals, automation opportunities and expected value.Partner with Product Managers to align product vision, roadmaps and delivery timelines.Support AI, automation and Copilot-enabled initiatives across HR products and services.Design future-state HR processes and identify opportunities to simplify and automate employee journeys.Apply SAFe Agile practices, including Program Increment planning and continuous backlog exploration.Use JIRA to support backlog management, sprint planning and delivery tracking.Engage stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations and maintain alignment with strategic objectives.Lead and mentor a team of Solution Owners, balancing hands-on delivery with effective delegation.Drive continuous improvement and innovation across HR systems, services and processes.Oversee solutions from prioritisation through adoption and value delivery.Ensure solutions are delivered on time and meet business and compliance requirements.Research and benchmark external practices and emerging technology, building networks with other organisations where appropriate

**Who you are**
---------------

You have:

* Proven experience as a Solution Owner or Product Owner within the HR domain.
* A strong understanding of HR systems and processes across the Hire-to-Retire lifecycle.
* Experience managing enterprise solutions end to end, from prioritisation through adoption and value delivery.
* Practical experience of stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering and expectation management.
* Proficiency in JIRA and SAFe Agile methodologies.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and mentoring team members.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities, with a focus on simplification and measurable value.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across functions.
* A Computer Science or IT Engineering background.
* SAFe Agile certification or an equivalent qualification.
* Experience with HR platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors or similar systems.
* Exposure to integrations involving AI, automation or other digital tools.
* Experience contributing to enterprise-level HR transformation programmes.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

The opportunity to shape global HR services and employee journeys across the Hire-to-Retire lifecycle.Ownership of a portfolio with direct visibility of business outcomes, adoption and value delivery.Exposure to AI, automation and Copilot-enabled HR service delivery.Opportunities to work with global Product Managers, stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams.Scope to influence future-state processes and enterprise HR transformation.The opportunity to lead and develop a team of Solution Owners.Experience of applying SAFe Agile practices within a global HR technology environment

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Advanced product ownership across complex HR services and employee journeys.AI, automation and Copilot use-case identification within HR operations.Future-state process design and HR service simplification.Portfolio and backlog prioritisation based on business value.Enterprise stakeholder alignment and cross-functional collaboration.Value-realisation, adoption and continuous-improvement techniques.People leadership, mentoring and effective delegation.External benchmarking of HR technology and digital service practices

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Head of IT - GIFT
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

Our GCIO organisation plays a critical role for the bank. This team partners with our businesses to build the platforms, systems, and products that our customers use every day. This team keeps people’s money and data safe, and is at the forefront of driving innovation for our businesses, customers, and colleagues.

**Role purpose**

The Technology Country Management role is accountable to the Regional CIO for in-country business relationships, execution of global and regional Technology strategy, and management/oversight of local execution, change portfolio, and Technology services within the country.

This role provides end-to-end leadership across engineering, delivery, governance, regulatory engagement and audit readiness—ensuring Technology outcomes are secure, resilient, compliant, and aligned to business priorities.

**Key responsibilities**

**Country Technology leadership & stakeholder management**

* Provide in-country oversight and coordination for Technology services and business relationships, managing resources across multiple Technology disciplines.
* Act as the senior Technology point of contact for country stakeholders, ensuring priorities, risks, and dependencies are clearly understood and managed.
* Attend relevant COO-chaired governance committees, leading key Technology discussions and driving decisions to closure.

**Strategy execution & roadmap ownership**

* Drive and implement the Technology strategy defined by the Group CIO, GB/GF CIOs, Technology Function Heads and Regional CIO—translating it into an executable country plan.
* Develop and maintain the Country Technology roadmap, covering all relevant GB/GF and Technology Function activities, aligned to business objectives and regulatory expectations.
* Ensure local demand is clearly articulated into global portfolios, with the right data to enable prioritisation and investment decisions.

**Regulatory engagement, audit management & control assurance**

* Maintain strong relationships with relevant regulators and government stakeholders, supporting the Regional CIO and country leadership in regulatory engagement.
* Face regulators as required: present Technology strategy, control posture, resilience, cyber/operational risk management, and remediation progress with clear, evidence-based narratives.
* Lead Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, and regulatory examinations: coordinate walkthroughs, evidence packs, management responses, and closure plans.
* Ensure audit findings and regulatory observations are remediated on time with clear ownership, milestones, and sustainable control improvements.

**Engineering leadership (Cloud, API, DevSecOps, AI)**

* Provide strong engineering oversight across modern technology stacks, including:  
    
  Cloud engineering (architecture, security, resilience, cost governance)  
  API platforms/integration (design standards, lifecycle management, reliability)  
  DevSecOps (CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, policy-as-code, release governance)  
  AI/ML enablement (responsible adoption, model risk considerations, data controls, secure deployment patterns)
* Ensure engineering practices meet enterprise standards for security-by-design, reliability, observability, and operational resilience.
* Oversee application development, remediation, and service management for non GB/GF CIO-owned solutions/services (where applicable).

**Portfolio, programme & project management (large change portfolio)**

* Provide management and oversight of the country change portfolio, including prioritisation, sequencing, dependency management, and benefits tracking.
* Lead governance for a large portfolio of programmes and projects, ensuring delivery discipline across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality.
* Drive consistent delivery reporting (RAID, milestones, financials, resource plans) and intervene early to unblock delivery issues.
* Ensure change governance supports safe delivery (release controls, change approvals, incident learnings, post-implementation reviews).

**Service management, incident leadership & operational resilience**

* Provide full oversight and advice on Technology issues in-country, including resolution of critical incidents and coordination of key deployments.
* Own end-to-end development and running of non GB/GF CIO-owned country Technology services, including problem management and change governance to ensure service quality.
* Strengthen operational resilience through improved monitoring, capacity planning, DR readiness, and continuous service improvement.

**Financial, resource & people leadership**

* Own direct cost and headcount management for country teams, including annual planning and forecasting.
* Lead people change activities (including restructuring where required) in partnership with HR and in line with local requirements.
* Build a high-performing culture with clear objectives, talent development, and strong accountability.

**Skills and experience (requirements)**

* Senior Technology leadership experience in a regulated environment, with proven delivery of country-level execution and service oversight.
* Demonstrated experience facing regulators and managing audit/exam activities, including evidence preparation and remediation closure.
* Strong engineering depth across Cloud, APIs, DevSecOps and modern software delivery practices; working knowledge of AI/ML delivery and governance.
* Proven capability managing a large portfolio with strong programme and project management discipline (multi-year roadmaps, complex dependencies, multiple stakeholders).
* Excellent communication and executive presence—able to translate complex technical topics into clear business and regulatory outcomes.
* Strong governance mindset: risk management, control ownership, operational resilience, and service management.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

**Pro-Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

title: Specialist - Experience Platform & Integrations
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

**The Role**
------------

As the Specialist - Experience Platform & Integrations, you will drive the administration, governance, and technical evolution of our core enterprise feedback systems (currently Qualtrics). Being part of the “System Owner” team you will have to blend robust technical aptitude with foundational project management skills, in order to safeguard the platform's integrity while architecting extensions into broader data ecosystems.

This role bridges the gap between operations (running the existing Qualtrics setup) and IT (extending the functionality by analyzing, developing and deploying new integrations) combining daily system administration and stakeholder enablement with advanced survey architecture and insightful reporting**.**

**Primary Mandate:** Serve as a core member of the system owners team, governing the full portfolio of customer satisfaction projects, core metrics, and our evolving suite of analytics tools.

**Broader Impact:** Embrace secondary opportunities to showcase your technical skills and forward-thinking mindset by contributing to broader technology projects within Customer Service beyond the core survey platform

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Survey management:** Create, configure, and maintain surveys, forms, and questionnaires.
* **User administration:** Create/manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and access, across CX and EX platforms.
* **Workflows:** Set up automated workflows, notifications, and actions based on survey responses. Monitor and maintain workflows connected to HRIS and EX automation triggers connected to Employee lifecycle events.
* **Data management:** Monitor survey data, Imports, exports, integrations, and data quality.
* **Troubleshooting:** Resolve issues related to surveys, permissions, workflows, and platform functionality.
* **Governance:** Ensure proper usage, security, access controls, and data privacy.
* **Support:** Help HR, CX, EX, or other business teams use Qualtrics effectively.
* Demonstrate tech-stack flexibility and open-mindedness about the existing tech stack, with a clear readiness to transition away from Qualtrics to alternative platforms if business needs dictate a change.
* Act as a trusted advisor to operations, providing best-practice guidance and suggestions on survey design rather than acting as a passive order-taker.
* Own the integration roadmap for the platform, architecting and overseeing seamless data connections between the survey system, current enterprise applications, and future tech stack expansions.
* Drive end-to-end integration strategy, bridging the feedback platform with existing and future enterprise systems to create a unified data ecosystem.
* Be able to expand platform extensibility by designing and possibly introducing new databases or data lake entities, ensuring enterprise repositories are enriched with Customer Experience (CX) or Employee Experience (EX) data for future connections.

**Technical & System Requirements**
-----------------------------------

* **Platform Expertise:** 4+ years of hands-on administration, governance, and advanced survey architecture experience in Qualtrics (CoreXM, CX, EX). Certification (e.g., Qualtrics CX/EX Expert) is highly preferred.
* **Integrations & APIs:** Proven experience building and managing APIs, webhooks, ETL pipelines to connect feedback platforms with enterprise ecosystems (CRMs like Salesforce/Zendesk, HRIS like Workday/SuccessFactors, and BI tools).
* **Data Engineering & Analytics:** Proficiency in SQL and database design. Experience designing data lake entities, data models, or staging tables (AWS, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Azure) to merge CX/EX data with core operational databases.
* **Scripting & Customization:** Functional knowledge of JavaScript, HTML/CSS for advanced survey customization, embedded data manipulation, and dynamic display logic.
* **Platform Flexibility:** Hands-on familiarity or willingness to transition to alternative Experience Management (XM) platforms (e.g., Medallia, Sprinklr, QuestionPro) if strategic needs shift**.**

**Functional & Governance Requirements**
----------------------------------------

* **Lifecycle & Workflow Automation:** Track record of setting up automated HRIS-triggered employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, exit, pulse) and closed-loop CX actioning workflows.
* **Data Privacy & Governance:** Strong understanding of global and local data protection regulations (GDPR, India's DPDP Act) to enforce role-based access control (RBAC), data masking, and secure data handling.
* **Consultative Survey Design:** Ability to advise cross-functional teams (HR, Customer Service, Product) on survey methodology, scale design, bias reduction, and metric selection (NPS, CSAT, CES, eNPS).

**Professional Experience & Education**

**About the Role**

**As a** **Data Modeler at TVH****, you will play a central role in shaping how our global organization structures, understands, and leverages its data. Operating across** **all core business domains** **(e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.**

**You will translate diverse cross\-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Logical \& Physical Data Model Design:**


	+ **Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and** **Logical Data Models (LDM)** **across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.**
	+ **Translate LDMs into optimized** **Physical Data Models (PDM)** **tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.**
	+ **Reverse\-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.**
	+ **Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity\-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.**
* **Domain Alignment \& Standards Governance:**


	+ **Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.**
	+ **Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.**
	+ **Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross\-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.**
* **Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration:**


	+ **Work hand\-in\-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.**
	+ **Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.**
	+ **Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.**
* **Model Optimization \& Quality:**


	+ **Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.**
	+ **Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.**

**Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** **focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.**
* **Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity\-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.**
* **Strong proficiency in** **SQL** **for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.**
* **Hands\-on experience with modern** **cloud data warehouses** **(preferably** **GCP BigQuery****, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.**
* **Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).**
* **Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.**
* **Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.**

**Preferred Skills**

* **Experience with** **Data Vault 2\.0** **modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.**

* **Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).**
* **Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.**
